screening_decisions.reason: Review article summarizing literature on drug-induced liver injury, not a clinical trial of paracetamol for migraine treatment.
Study focuses on aspirin absorption during migraine, not paracetamol treatment.
Epidemiological study analyzing paracetamol sales and overdose trends, not a clinical trial for migraine treatment.

Multicentre, randomized, double-blind, single-dose, placebo-controlled parallel group study of fixed combination containing paracetamol (200mg) vs paracetamol alone and other comparators for headache/migraine. 1743 patients enrolled, well above 10 per arm threshold.
Review article on mechanism of action of paracetamol, not a clinical trial.

Randomized, double-blind, three-way cross-over comparison of 1g paracetamol plus domperidone 30mg, domperidone 20mg, or placebo for migraine. 46 patients completed study, exceeds 10 per arm threshold.
